state.text:
# Separate the worker pools
Separate worker pools keep exports from delaying interactive requests.

Today both jobs draw from the same pool of eight workers. An export keeps a worker occupied until its file is complete. When eight exports run, interactive requests wait. Assign exports to their own pool and reserve the existing pool for interactive requests.

## Conclusion
In summary, separate worker pools keep exports from delaying interactive requests. Giving each workload its own workers prevents exports from blocking interactive work.

# Weekly dependency updates
We will begin by looking at the importance of dependency updates, then examine the key considerations, and finally outline practical steps for a successful update process. This guide provides everything you need to understand dependency updates.

Run the updater every Monday. Assign the resulting pull request to whoever is on maintenance duty. Merge patch releases after the tests pass; schedule major releases separately.

# Reorder the settings menu
Move the notifications entry above the appearance entry. Both pages retain their current controls, and saved preferences will not change.

Organizations that ignore this opportunity will find themselves left behind. What looks like a small menu adjustment is really a test of whether we can survive in an increasingly demanding world. Our long-term relevance depends on getting this right.
